grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态与 spend 时间结构（叙事）。

points.title: 被动叙事
points.explanation: The wallet was found / it was returned 被动句贯穿"失物招领"场景。

examples.en: The whole village was sorry to lose such a good postmaster.
examples.cn: 全村人都为失去这么好的邮递员而惋惜。

points.title: 百分比的精确表达
points.explanation: a hundred per cent（百分之百）；per cent of 后接单数谓语用单数。

examples.en: Sam was sure the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
examples.cn: Sam 确信钱包肯定被某个村民捡到了。
